notes: All percentages refer to training tokens, not document counts.
Targets are separate from measured availability; shortfalls must be reported, not hidden by repeated samples.
Only one export format per source is read. Fineweb V3 sample archives are audit-only because of length/language/level mismatch.
Educational-web filtering is not factual verification. Synthetic dialogue retains generator/source provenance.
Original base validation documents and original SFT validation prompts stay out of training.
Validation pools are unique and are never repeated to meet training proportions.
Literal extraction/copy/cloze/JSON tasks are derived from supplied educational text, retain the parent split, and do not add independently verified facts.
Human-verified source labels do not establish whether an answer was human-written.
Curated training texts may also occur in ordinary base training replay; this is intentional reweighting, not extra unique knowledge.
